title: If I May: Polite Conditions
goal: Soften a statement or a request with si no me equivoco, si mal no recuerdo, si me permite and si no es molestia.
grammar: Polite si phrases in the present indicative

items: I can soften a statement or a request with si no me equivoco, si mal no recuerdo, si me permite and si no es molestia.
I can set these polite phrases off with commas.
I can use the new words for objections and polite disagreement.
